title: Proper Nouns & Capital Letters
subject: Language Arts
description: Names of people and places get a BIG letter!
steps: A proper noun is the special NAME of a person, place, or thing: Morgan, Jamaica, Kingston.
Proper nouns ALWAYS start with a capital letter.
Days and months are proper nouns too: Monday, June, December.
Every sentence also starts with a capital letter — and the word 'I' is always capital!

questions.prompt: Which word needs a capital letter?
questions.hint: It's the name of a country!
Names of places and days are proper nouns.

questions.correct: My friend Anna lives in May Pen.
questions.hint: Capitals for the first word, names, and places!
